subject: [hw] opus-kern start: K02/IK VENC audit + patches 0310/0311/0312
body: Opus kernel reviewer (main session request). Auditing K02 nord2_vcodec.inc + IK relay against the MT6893 tree for the VENC path; producing 0310 (= old hwcodec 0299 jpegdev/vcodec/relay, renumbered: 0299/0300 are the surface-budget patches already in the phone kernel q10in), 0311 (VENC corrections + RWVC_DMA_INFO as in the rev-2 header) and 0312 (autotest command 8: VENC steps 0-4 over USB, tools/hwv.py). Early findings for hw-ip/hw-iv: (1) vpud maps VENC/VENC_C1 with len 0x3000 (host/PROGRESS.md) but K02 windows are 0x2000 -> 0311 makes them 0x3000; (2) Linux routes larb7/8 ports 5,6,13,14,21,22 (NBM/FCS) to MMSRAM via NON_SEC_CON bits 16-19 (smi_sysram_enable, mtk_vcodec_enc_pm.c:308-317); we route them to DRAM, so vcodecd must give the lib slbc_ready = 0 (venc_ipi_msg.h:404 / venc_common_if.c:487); (3) larb8 (VENC core 1) hangs off the MDP SMI common (smi_drv.c:215-232), so VENC_C1 needs the MDP domain on; Linux clock_on powers BOTH cores for any job (mtk_vcodec_enc_pm.c:271-282). I do not edit K02/IK files in place; my sources go to gpu/hwcodec/kern/p031x/.
